where: Every header (Winds Aloft, Fly with Kate!, Admin, Flight Academy, My Aircraft, My Account, Customers) is one shared recipe (templates/_app_header.html): Back, Programs, logo + name, hamburger, phone account icon, Switch role chips and the account menu in the same place everywhere.

Grid icon + the word Programs, left of the logo, in every header; hidden for single-program accounts. On the narrowest phones only the icon shows; on tablets/desktops the word shows when it fits (same rule as the other buttons).
Admin headings, shortcuts and role labels, the Reset Data headings, My Account headings, the walkthrough titles and the bounce messages all say Winds Aloft / Fly with Kate!.
detail: The Fly with Kate! walkthrough's first step and the Winds Aloft one are titled with the brand too (HUB-40 was undecided but is the same sentence as SEAM-3).

where: The login page at / is branded OpsHub with both logos and a Username or Email box; /portal/login, /flight/login and /login redirect to it; after a bounce you return to the page you wanted (?next=).
detail: The dead templates flight/login.html and customer_login.html are gone. flight/signup.html stays because the open /flight/signup route (FLY-01, fly builder) still renders it; nothing links to it any more. Bounces inside flight.py (fly builder's file) still land on the login page but without ?next=.

where: Log Out in the account menu (every header and the picker) uses the app's own confirm box ('Log out of OpsHub?'), says Logged out. and lands on the one login page; /portal/logout now does the same.
Back button at the left of the My Aircraft header (falls back to the owner dashboard) and of the Customers pages (now the Winds Aloft header).
One shared account menu in every header; owners get My Account at /portal/account (name, email, phone, password).
A student's nav tab is My Balance with a wallet icon; the account menu says My Account for everyone.
Customer pages render inside the Winds Aloft header; the admin's picker tile is Customers. Cards and buttons keep an accent colour.
detail: Because SEAM-11 gives everything My Aircraft a teal (not Admin's plum), the Customers card accent and buttons use that teal rather than plum.

where: Flight Academy / Ground School / Logbook stay a separate opt-in program with their own navy look; they now use the shared header recipe, branded Flight Academy.
detail: Per Frank's note Academy was NOT merged under the Fly with Kate! header - only the shared header recipe and the name were applied. The leaderboard-for-everyone idea in the note was not built (not an approved item).

where: My Aircraft tile, the Customers tile, the owner header and the Customers cards/buttons are teal; Admin keeps plum.

The Programs button opens a dropdown of every program this account can open plus All programs; the one-off Fly with Kate! button in the Winds Aloft nav and the Maintenance/Flight School buttons in the Admin header are gone.

Behind the scenes: every page declares a home-screen identity (templates/_app_identity.html) - Winds Aloft on shop, Admin, Customers, My Aircraft, the login page and the picker; Fly with Kate! on flight and Academy pages; My Account uses the program it was opened from. Never a neutral OpsHub icon.
detail: Decision for Frank: the login page and the picker (which has no single program) carry the Winds Aloft identity.

where: One shared flash-message include (templates/_flash_messages.html): full width with a close button on every program, including Academy and My Aircraft.
Every logged-out bounce says 'Please log in to continue.', lands on the one login page and returns you to the page you wanted after logging in.
detail: Bounces that happen inside flight.py (fly builder's file) say nothing and land on the login page without ?next=; the sentence and the return-to only cover the shop, admin, account and portal gates (auth.py).

where: The phone account icon next to the hamburger is on every header, Admin and My Account included (falls out of SEAM-1).
The owner portal and the Customers pages load the shared stylesheet (static/css/style.css) and nav-fit.js.

My Account buttons are Winds Aloft walkthrough / Fly with Kate! walkthrough / Flight Academy walkthrough; the owner's My Account has My Aircraft walkthrough. Three-stop tours start once on first visit to Flight Academy and to My Aircraft.

Behind the scenes: a login with Master Admin and no Fly with Kate! role gets the same hidden, non-bookable instructor profile a shop admin gets (on save and on login), so every Fly with Kate! page opens for them.
detail: The silent bounce itself lives in flight.py's login_required (fly builder's file), so its message was not changed; with the hidden profile a master admin is no longer bounced at all.
Concerned the View as someone / owner preview feature, which HUB-03 removed. The Switch role banner now shows on every header (Customers pages included) and on the picker.

where: The header chips say Switch role: and are the only way to look at the app as someone else. View as someone (menu item, /view-as/people, person view) and the owner preview (View as button on Customers) are gone; the yellow bar says Switched role: Tech with Back to my normal view.

detail: Only concerned the removed View as someone feature (HUB-03).

where: Each job in Job Costs has a Details expander listing parts by section (name, qty, price) and labor (who, hours, amount) with the total; money shows as $1,234.56.
Log Current Hours says 'Hobbs updated 30-09-2026 14:22 by Frank' (usdate filter), without the Owner - prefix when the viewer is that owner.

Log Reading: a reading lower than the last one asks 'Hobbs 123.5 is lower than the last reading 1234.5 - save anyway?' before saving; an empty form says 'Enter a Hobbs and/or Tach reading.' on the page itself.
Appointments waiting on the owner show a yellow 'Please confirm' badge with an exclamation icon, and the card gets the yellow border with an 'N to confirm' badge.
The found-item note row has a small camera button instead of the wide file picker; the chosen file name shows underneath.
The Academy header brand is the mortarboard + Flight Academy, linking to the Academy board, with Back and Programs beside it.

Behind the scenes: when Save Changes is refused (Name is required / can't remove your own admin access / can't deactivate yourself / bad pay rate), the form is re-drawn with everything typed - roles, email, flags, the new password - and the full Pay and Profiles sections.
The Accounts list stacks into cards on a phone with Edit beside the name, has no Password column, and dims inactive accounts; the password shows only on the Edit page behind a Show button.
New password boxes are hidden with a Show toggle; the confirm box only shows while hidden; at least 8 characters, said under the box and checked on save. Admin-set starting passwords are exempt.
A note under Username (account form) and under Email (customer form) explains using the same email and password so one login shows every program.

Every reset pop-up is titled with the action ('Delete 42 projects') and its button says the verb; Projects, Students, Instructors, Planes and Balances need RESET typed next to the button (checked on the server too); Squawks sits under Winds Aloft.
Restart / Reboot / Shut Down pop-ups are named per action. After Restart or Reboot a plain page waits, checks every few seconds and reloads itself; after Shut Down it shows the green-light steps.
Each reset result says how much was deleted, e.g. 'Deleted 42 projects (and their sections, labor and photos). Project numbering starts again at 001.'
Locked-until and attempt times show in local time in the app's format; Unlock says 'Unlocked frank - they can log in again now.'

Option (b): a shop-only login's My Account says phone alerts are for Fly with Kate! flying sessions only (Winds Aloft reminders go by email/text); Admin > Notifications says the same and why the list only has Fly with Kate! accounts.
A 'save first after changing anything' note sits above the two Send Test boxes, like the Wave page.
Test connection returns one box with a bullet list; turning the switch off asks 'Turn Wave invoicing off?' first (the switch flips back if cancelled).
Mark paid says 'Marked Sam paid $123.45 for the week of ...'; Undo asks and reports with the same detail; shop worker names link to their Labor Pay page.
The Admin tile reads 'Accounts, payroll, notifications, Wave, system & reset'; Jump into a program offers Winds Aloft (+ Billing), Fly with Kate! (+ Billing), Flight Academy and Customers.
No 'Back to ...' button at the top of My Account (header Back + bottom Cancel remain); the program list lives in the header's Programs button and the card keeps the role badges.
Reminders say 'Choose how you want reminders (email, text) and which reminders you want:'; the planning sentence is gone; walkthrough buttons are Winds Aloft walkthrough / Fly with Kate! walkthrough.
